edits.old: The field-level names of the capture block and of the store request beyond the legacy list, and the name of the rwb-document login, are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1018; ASM-1877); the baseline RWB-P5-E2024-CON fixes the names this story is built against.
edits.new: The store of RWB-P5-E1024-APP takes an optional capture block (`capturedAt`, `captureLatitude`, `captureLongitude`, `clientFileId`, `captureKind`) as an additive change of its request within major version 1 (GAP-1018; ASM-1877). The intake item is created by the intake submit of RWB-P5-E1057-CON, and RWB-P5-E1049-CON is read as the OCR pipeline that consumes the item. The baseline RWB-P5-E2024-CON declares the manifest as one JSON part named `manifest` and each file part named by its `clientFileId`; the item required set is `clientFileId`, `kind` and `capturedAt` (GAP-1019). A content type other than multipart/form-data is refused with 415; a refused type stays an item with status REFUSED and MSG-P5-001 at 201 (GAP-1019). The `Idempotency-Key` stored-answer window and the not-found message ID are Not specified in the source documents until the platform catalogue fixes them (GAP-1019). The name of the rwb-document login is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1018; ASM-1877). The field-app test client, the capture fixtures, the intake test profile, the SIT harness pack and the evidence format are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0406). The legacy Decision D6.5 is the routing tag that produced a capture; each document-attach entry carries DOCATT as the value of LOV-DECISION (GAP-1283). Each stored document and each item the store refuses has one DOCATT entry; a refused item's entry carries result REFUSED and its message ID, and a DUPLICATE item resolves to the entry of the item received first (GAP-1284).
